symptom: Read old value after set replacement on warmed key.
cause_chain: Symptom stale read -> cached branch returns cached old value -> set updates store without invalidation -> warmed-key replacement triggers -> separate store/cache dictionaries permit divergence. Test asserts store holds new value while get returns old, so failed writes are excluded. Unwarmed replacement passes.
fix: Invalidate only the written key in set.
verification: 3 unittest tests; before 2 failures; after all pass.
limitations: No thread-safety or distributed cache claim.
